title: A compiled XRechnung ruleset on the 60 e-invoice PDFs (preregistered, not blind)

run.id: compiled-ruleset corpus run: four arms over the 60 PDFs of the e-invoice PDF run, its blind extractor unchanged
run.ruleset: xrechnung-cius + xrechnung-profile (compiled from KoSIT XRechnung v2.6.0 and CEN EN16931 v1.3.15, compiler 0.1.0), with CEN + Peppol recompiled as reference

not_shipped.reason: the run's harness (the prereg names it by an abbreviated hash). It names the authors' private folders, so it does not ship.
the run's scorer, which wrote results/results.json. It names the authors' private folders, so it does not ship.

the manifest of the 60 rendered e-invoice PDFs (pinned in results/run-receipt.json). The corpus is not in this tree, so the extraction step cannot be rerun from it; the table re-tallies from the per-document results.
the blind extractor of the e-invoice PDF run, unchanged (pinned in results/run-receipt.json). Not copied here: the same bytes ship in x1-einvoice-pdf/lib/extract.mjs

rerun.detail: The four compiled rulesets ship in rulesets/, but the harness and scorer name the authors' folders and do not ship, and the 60 rendered PDFs are not in this tree. The extractor it reused ships in x1-einvoice-pdf/lib/extract.mjs.

misses.description: under EN 16931 + XRechnung, the extractor's terms only, X1-D15 PASSed: the invoice currency (BT-5) was removed from the page, the blind extractor invented one, and the compiled presence check passed it; R1 predicted no WRONG PASS of this type

compiler 0.1.0 left the currency-count conjunct of BR-CO-15 uncompiled (a cardinality test), so three currency defects (X1-D04, X1-D14, X1-D19) PASSed under the scoped XRechnung profile, where the profile itself would catch them
misses.fixed_by: compiler 0.1.1 compiles the currency count (a post-hoc re-run, listed outside the bench rule)

misses.description: EN 16931 and XRechnung have no line-math rule (that is Peppol's R120), so the four line-math defects (X1-D01, X1-D06, X1-D11, X1-D16) PASS under the scoped XRechnung profile

the full XRechnung profiles require fields this extractor never reads (BT-10, BT-24, the seller's address and contact), so they hold every document open: they cannot pass, though EN 16931 + XRechnung still catches the VAT-breakdown and payable defects
X1-N06 (a stamped scan): false FAIL on BR-CL-03 in both scoped arms (and on R051 and CL007 in the Peppol arm): the amounts' currency was read as "CEN"
X1-N20 (a rotated scan): false FAIL on BR-CO-10 in both scoped arms (and on R120 in the Peppol arm) from an OCR misread

label: post-hoc
audit: no new audit: the planted defects are known by construction, and the reference reading is the corpus's own ground-truth fields; the run's author, an AI agent (Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)), wrote the predictions and bars before the run
